who_moves.Dispatched: Technician ('on site'; today an SMS to dispatch, often forgotten)
who_moves.On Site: Technician / dispatcher (quote or parts needed, or done)
who_moves.Waiting on client: Client approves or declines the quote; dispatch records it (I: dispatch emails the quote, 00:33:29)
who_moves.Complete: Dispatcher, once the job sheet is in

stages.note: Quote to client (over NTE) and parts order to supplier can be open at once; the return visit is booked only when both are done. One stage column can't hold that: the Quote and Parts order records carry their own status and a process joins them and moves the job to Return visit booked. New statuses asked for: Waiting on client, Waiting on parts, Return visit booked (W1 00:59:16).

who_moves.Draft: Dispatcher (smaller jobs, Word template) or supervisor (big ones)
who_moves.Sent to client: Client (property manager); the dispatcher records the answer

who_moves.Requested: Technician up to $500; a supervisor above that

roles.name: Dispatcher
roles.does: Logs jobs, works out the SLA due time, assigns and rings technicians, updates statuses, builds small quotes
roles.approves: After-hours callouts up to the limit (disputed)

roles.name: After-hours dispatcher
roles.does: Covers after hours from home; writes overnight jobs in a Word doc
roles.approves: After-hours callouts up to the limit

roles.name: On-call manager
roles.does: Approves after-hours callouts above the dispatcher's limit

roles.name: Technician
roles.does: Attends, diagnoses, does the work, fills in the job sheet

roles.name: Field technician supervisor
roles.does: Builds quotes for big jobs, orders big parts

roles.name: Operations Manager
roles.does: Owns SLA reporting to clients; signs off the workshop playback

roles.name: Operations coordinator
roles.does: Corrects the monthly SLA report by hand (two days a month)

roles.name: Billing officer
roles.does: Rewrites tech notes into invoice lines, keys invoices into MYOB, uploads to client portals

rules.rule: SLA attend-within time per client contract and priority
rules.value: P1 4 hours metro (2 hours for the hospitals); P2 next business day; varies by contract

rules.rule: SLA clock pauses while the job is waiting on the client's quote approval, where the contract allows
rules.value: Contract by contract: most property managers, not the hospitals (Greg to confirm the list)

rules.rule: Not-to-exceed amount per contract: under it the job just gets done; over it needs a quote
rules.value: $1,000 for most; $500 for a couple of councils; $2,500 for one shopping centre group

rules.rule: Internal approval before a quote goes to the client
After-hours callout: dispatcher approves up to a limit, the on-call manager above it
rules.value: $1,500 (dispatch's after-hours guide) or $2,000 (Greg: raised last financial year)

rules.rule: Invoice more than this over the approved quote goes back to operations to explain before it's sent
Work over the NTE without an approved quote can't be billed (written off)
Return visit booked only when the client has approved the quote (if any) and the part has arrived (if any)
Technician must hold the site's induction where the site requires one; checked at assignment
rules.value: Per site: induction required yes/no; per technician: inductions held (kept in a spreadsheet today)

rules.rule: Every parts order gets a MYOB purchase order number, recorded on the job

open.ask: Is the dispatcher's after-hours callout limit $1,500 or $2,000? (The after-hours guide and the team still use $1,500.)
How often should completed jobs go to MYOB, and clients and sites come back: as it happens, same day, or end of day? (Leanne would like same day at least.)
Which contracts allow the SLA clock to pause while a quote is with the client?
Once first-time fix can be measured, what target would you set? (No number needed yet.)
Who should own invoice lag (job complete to invoice sent): finance, operations, or both?
How many people in finance process invoices, including the AP helpers at month-end and the part-timer in Melbourne?
Roughly how many return visits a month, and how many of those are waiting on a part?
Which client contracts have data clauses we should check our written answer on AI and client data against?
Which of the three client portals have an API, and can you share their names or documentation?
Which fleet GPS system are the vans on, and could it share van locations with the new system?
Do you want job history brought across from JobTrak, and if so how far back?
Is matching supplier invoices to jobs something you'd want in the new system, or does it stay with accounts payable in MYOB?
Should a short client feedback survey after each job be on the list? (Not ranked in workshop 1.)
Send the written answer on where client data is processed by AI, what's kept and what can be switched off (governance pack can-say lines; Creatio security for the rest)
